ver: Version counter. Starts at 1; incremented on every write.
meta.title: Application name, copied from PRD meta.title.
meta.updated_at: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last write.
framework: Primary backend framework detected from arch_spec.tech_stack, e.g. 'express', 'fastapi', 'django', 'spring-boot', 'gin', 'laravel'.
folders_created: List of folders created as part of the scaffold, as relative paths from project root.
files_generated: Complete list of scaffold files generated (entry points, config files, app factory, .gitignore, etc.), as relative paths from project root.
entry_points: List of primary entry point files (e.g. 'src/index.ts', 'main.py', 'manage.py'), as relative paths.
setup_notes: Developer notes about scaffold decisions — framework conventions chosen, deviations from defaults, first-run setup instructions. Empty array if none.
